```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
```



```{r}
ref_cgmap_file = "~/iproject/BSReadSim/TestData/test2/test.CGmap.gz"
sim_cgmap_file = "~/iproject/BSReadSim/TestData/test2/sim.CGmap.gz"
bsbolt_cgmap_file = "~/iproject/BSReadSim/TestData/test2/bsbolt.CGmap.gz"
```


```{r}
ref_cgmap = fread(ref_cgmap_file)
sim_cgmap = fread(sim_cgmap_file)
bsbolt_cgmap = fread(bsbolt_cgmap_file)


ref_cgmap$site = paste0(ref_cgmap$V1, ref_cgmap$V3)
sim_cgmap$site = paste0(sim_cgmap$V1, sim_cgmap$V3)
bsbolt_cgmap$site = paste0(bsbolt_cgmap$V1, bsbolt_cgmap$V3)

comb_df = inner_join(ref_cgmap, sim_cgmap, by = "site") 
comb_df_cg = comb_df %>% filter(V4.x == "CG")

comb_df2 =inner_join(ref_cgmap, bsbolt_cgmap, by = "site")  
comb_df2_cg =comb_df2 %>% filter(V4.x == "CG") 
```


```{r}
ggplot(comb_df %>% filter(V4.x == "CG")) +
  aes(x = V6.x, y = V6.y) +
  geom_hex() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c()
```


```{r}
plot_sim = smoothScatter(comb_df_cg$V6.y ~ comb_df_cg$V6.x, nrpoints = 1000, xlab = "Reference methylation profile", ylab = "Simulated methylation profile") 
plot_sim2= as_ggplot(plot_sim)
```
